title: MONSOON DUEL: Mass Fight BGM in the Rain (original score)
description:
Mazhai, two warriors, one hero. The rain stops, the hall goes silent, and the hook slams back with whistles and chenda. A South Indian mass fight BGM made for that theatre moment.

For fans of Tamil, Malayalam and Telugu mass BGM, hero fight scenes, interval blocks and slow-motion edits. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Monsoon Duel (India cut), an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
